matching_rule: Exactly one specification for every planned document ID in source-document-register.json; no extra IDs.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Neutral case summary with restricted cover, document control, persons, non-operative proposed charges, source-backed master chronology, alleged-course and incident map, order/translation/interpreter/witness states, live issues and next decisions. It must not express a guilt conclusion.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 15-22 pages; narrative 300-500 substantive words/page and chronology 12-26 meaningful sourced events/page, with legitimate sparse control/approval pages.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital accessible PDF planned from controlled word-processing source; searchable text, tagged headings, repeated table headers and stable links; no scanned summary.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: A revised chronology, uncertain dates expressed as ranges and genuinely outstanding decisions are permitted with dated versions. No cosmetic errors are added to simulate authenticity.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Restricted domestic-abuse case material. Defendant-client version excludes complainant address, child/family, medical/support and risk detail beyond necessity; court/CPS/solicitor/internal variants follow authorised scope.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated incident narratives, copied statements, generic domestic-abuse guidance, decorative timeline pages, duplicated order text or blank padding.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: course allegation remains distinct from incidents
translation and interpreter states not collapsed
client redactions do not alter legal meaning

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Incident and first-account suite: incident/response logs, 999 call register and audio transcript, BWV master/clip register and transcript, officer and neighbour statements, continuity history and account-comparison index. It records response and media provenance without deciding admissibility or truth.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 30-42 pages; incident logs 10-25 entries/page, statements 250-450 words/page, transcripts 35-70 timed turns/page and one to four necessary stills/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native audio/video external; born-digital media registers and timed transcripts; signed scanned statements and ordinary BWV stills allowed. Compression, variable lighting and ordinary radio noise may exist without artificial degradation.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Natural overlap, inaudibles, dispatcher clock variance, late officer correction and revised transcript are legitimate if explicit. Master media remains immutable and derivatives versioned.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Home interior, address, children, health and third-party voices restricted. Defendant/client/court exports contain only authorised relevant extracts; unredacted custodian and redaction reasons recorded.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated full transcript per clip, near-identical BWV stills, duplicate incident log renderings, invented continuity events or empty media rows.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: 999/BWV position is not shown as hearsay ruling
stills preserve aspect ratio and source time
redaction layers are irreversible in exported copy

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Translation-controlled statement set: Romanian signed original, original-language continuation pages, certified English translation, translator certificate, paragraph-alignment table, revision/challenge log and service/version record. The original remains authoritative for the maker's words; the translation enables authorised use.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 18-26 pages; original and translation each use 250-450 words/page or natural handwritten density; alignment table 8-18 paragraph pairs/page; certificate normally 1-2 pages. Languages need not paginate identically.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Romanian original planned as a legible signed scan preserving handwriting/marks; certified English translation born-digital and signed/certified; no text overlay on the original; Unicode/diacritics retained and searchable where source permits.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Natural pagination differences, an uncertain idiom marked by translator, one certified correction and a quality challenge are permitted with full history. Earlier certified version remains visible and no change is back-applied.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Complainant-sensitive statement. Address/contact/child data redacted consistently but separately in original and translation with a controlled redaction map; only authorised served versions reach defence/court/client outputs.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No machine translation labelled certified, no repeated side-by-side full text solely for length, no invented translator biography, no paraphrase presented as translation and no duplicated certificates.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: qualified human certification fields remain blank until genuine review
paragraph linkage is complete and one-to-one or exception logged
transcript is not mislabeled as translation

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Interpreter lifecycle register covering need identification, language/dialect, requests, providers, booking/confirmation, absence/cancellation, replacement, attendance, identity/credentials, event log, quality concern, review and remedy. It records service provision, not statement content or translation certification.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-18 pages; lifecycle table 8-20 events/page, booking notices 4-10/page-equivalent and quality-review narrative 250-450 words/page. Real emails/forms may leave legitimate whitespace.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital booking exports, emails/forms and lifecycle schedule; signed attendance sheet may be scanned. Interpreter-event records do not reproduce privileged consultation content or purport to be certified translations.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Late booking, absent first interpreter, replacement details, corrected arrival time and unresolved quality concern are legitimate if sourced and versioned. Booking is never backfilled as attendance.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Provider contact, complainant address and legal consultation content minimised. Solicitor/CPS/court receive relevant procedural records; defendant-client output receives necessary explanation without provider/private contact detail; internal review is controlled.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No duplicate booking confirmations, generic interpreter guidance, invented credentials, repeated attendance sheets, empty lifecycle rows or transcript/translation text used as padding.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: absent and replacement interpreters cannot share attendance falsely
quality concern not shown as upheld without outcome
timeline aligns with police/court event times

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Device/platform acquisition report plus message and call chronology schedules: device/account/person distinction, selection/filtering methodology, conversation and call tables, attachments, deletions/gaps and analyst limitations. It supports alleged-course analysis without treating display identity as authorship.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 30-42 pages; methodology 250-450 words/page, 12-28 meaningful message/call rows/page and no more than four necessary screenshots/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native extraction remains external; searchable born-digital schedules with stable IDs and legible wrapping; screenshots are secondary aids with ordinary device scaling and linked native locators.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Timezone correction, duplicate platform event, missing attachment, changed display name, deleted-event marker and expanded selection are legitimate with explicit version history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Intimate, child and unrelated third-party communications minimised. Full extraction role-limited; client/court receive authorised selections and redaction log; cross-matter conversations excluded.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated screenshot/schedule content, irrelevant long chat sequences, one-message-per-page layouts, invented metadata or duplicated quoted-message chains.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: display identity not equated with person
long text and call tables do not clip
incident tags are analyst labels not findings

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Focused medical, support and risk section: scoped requests, provider records/extracts, clinician/support statements, risk-assessment provenance, viewing/minimisation log, expert limitation where relied upon and version/service decisions. It records observations and support needs without determining truth.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 16-24 pages; focused clinical/support notes 200-420 words/page, risk tables 8-18 items/page and forms retain authentic purposeful whitespace.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed scanned provider forms/letters and born-digital focused extracts; original clinical formatting/abbreviations preserved where legible; colour used only for necessary clinical figures.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Clinical abbreviations, contemporaneous correction, incomplete historic period and updated risk/support assessment are legitimate with dates and author. Earlier versions remain visible.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Special-category health/support/child data. Only proportionate relevant extracts included; addresses and collateral history redacted. Client output avoids unnecessary detail; court use is authorised and state-labelled.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No wholesale medical/support files, repeated normal findings, generic domestic-abuse risk text, duplicate assessments or decorative body maps/charts.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: support need not treated as guilt proof
redactions do not conceal necessary provenance
forms and handwriting readable or marked unreadable

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Order and service register containing authenticated family/civil orders, variations/discharges, service evidence, criminal bail conditions, order-term comparison, alleged-breach mapping and operative/superseded chronology. It keeps forum, terms, service/knowledge and legal effect distinct.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 22-32 pages; orders keep authentic seals/signature fields and whitespace, term-comparison tables 6-16 substantive rows/page and chronology 8-18 events/page.
required_fields_headings_and_provenance: order type and non-operative legal-review state
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Court-issued-looking born-digital or sealed scans, with service certificates/returns as scans or exports. Exact terms reproduced once in the authoritative order; comparison schedule cites term numbers rather than reprinting full text.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Different court templates, genuine stamp/scanner skew, corrected party spelling, later variation and disputed/failed service attempt are legitimate when preserved; operative version clearly identified only from source.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Family/child/address information tightly restricted and redacted by version. Defence receives relevant served material; client summary does not reveal protected current location; open court bundle uses authorised redactions.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No duplicate full orders, repeated terms in every schedule, invented service attempts, decorative seals, blank order templates or generic legal commentary.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: operative and superseded versions visually distinct
service evidence maps to correct order/version
bail and family/civil terms not merged
protected addresses removed from all layers
comparison rows cite exact source terms

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Participation and support section: retraction/withdrawal statement, current-wishes record, contact attempts, reason/fear evidence where lawfully recorded, witness-availability log, support assessment, special-measures application/response/direction and implementation plan. It separates wishes, availability and evidence use.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-20 pages; statements/assessments 250-450 words/page, contact/availability logs 8-20 events/page and forms/orders retain authentic whitespace.
required_fields_headings_and_provenance: exact scope of retraction or withdrawal
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Signed scanned statements where appropriate, born-digital contact logs and current-form-style applications/directions; confidential supplement kept as separate controlled file.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Changed wishes, missed contact, health/fear-related uncertainty, revised application and partial direction are legitimate with date/source; prior states remain auditable.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Safety planning, address, support-provider and confidential special-measures detail restricted. Defendant-client/open versions contain only necessary authorised information; court direction governs use.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated withdrawal narrative, speculative motivation, generic support material, duplicate contact logs, blank application forms or fabricated direction reasons.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: confidential supplement excluded from open exits
changed wishes do not silently overwrite prior version

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Procedural application/disposal suite: hearsay/res-gestae notices or recorded positions, evidence and responses, hearing/ruling; restraining-order proposal, complainant views and order/ruling; PC4 time-limit calculation record, charge/discontinuance decision, notice, service and count-status history. Every stage is provenance-linked.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 18-28 pages; applications/decisions 250-500 words/page, procedural tables 8-18 events/page and orders/notices retain authentic field density and whitespace.
required_fields_headings_and_provenance: legal/rule source marked pending qualified review where unresolved
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital application, notice, count-status and calculation records; sealed/signed court order may be scanned. Each operative document stands alone with stable identifiers; no simulated official form without review.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Amended application, adjournment, corrected calculation, complainant-view update, draft discontinuance notice and later service event are legitimate only when dated. Blank human decisions remain blank until qualified review.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Fear/support/address evidence and internal charging reasoning restricted; court/defence receive authorised application material; privileged/internal advice excluded; client receives accurate count/order state without protected details.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied generic legal tests, duplicate blank forms, invented rulings, repeated order terms, artificial deadline worksheets or multiple cosmetic discontinuance notices.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: res-gestae position not promoted to ruling
proposed restraining order not shown as made
time-limit inputs/source and human decision state visible
protected facts absent from open/client exits

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Defence and disclosure/trial-preparation section: suspect interview index/transcript, defence statement, MG6-style schedules and disclosure decisions, defence requests/responses, later-service log, privilege/sensitivity flags, counsel extracts and trial action list. It preserves maker, item and service states.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 20-30 pages; interview transcript 35-70 turns/page, defence/counsel narrative 300-520 words/page, schedules 10-25 substantive rows/page and action lists 8-20 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native interview audio external with born-digital transcript; signed defence statement and court correspondence may be scans; disclosure schedules born-digital searchable tables with stable row IDs and no hidden columns.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Inaudibles, corrected transcript, amended defence statement, late-added disclosure item and superseded schedule are legitimate with full version history. Deleted rows are not silently removed.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Defence privilege and internal counsel advice have zero leakage to CPS/court/co-participants; sensitive complainant/child data minimised; client receives appropriate advice/output rather than internal notes; closed/internal schedules remain role-limited.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated interview extracts, boilerplate schedule rows, duplicated statements, generic counsel text, artificial empty rows or multiple renderings of the same schedule.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: trial actions align to source and operative count states
